title: Archived session still shows a Send invites button that only opens a 'Un-archive' note
what_happens: On an archived session the header offers 'Send invites' (and Copy join link is rightly hidden). The dialog has the lists greyed out and 'Un-archive the session to send invites.'
who_hurts: An admin looking at an old session is offered an action that can't happen; Dane agreed before that an archived page shouldn't read like a live one.
suggested_fix: Hide InvitesButton when session.archived_at is set, like Copy join link (page.tsx, same !session.archived_at check).
rule: established pattern: Copy join link is hidden for archived sessions; earlier agreed finding on archived pages
